title: 日本ダービーの後に・宙吊り

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon runs a magnificent race in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Only the Kikuka Sho remains in the Triple Crown tour. However, Agnes Tachyon reminds me not to get my hopes up and returns to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still uncertain as to whether or not she'll run in the Kikuka Sho, we begin our preparations all the same.
